cards.example_en: We explored several European cities during our summer holiday.
cards.example_zh: 暑假期间，我们游览了几座欧洲城市。
cards.explain_zh: 首字母大写；前用a而非an，不等同于欧盟的。

cards.example_en: Many European countries have invested in railway networks to reduce dependence on short domestic flights.
cards.example_zh: 许多欧洲国家投资建设铁路网，以减少对短途国内航班的依赖。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: It was too windy to eat lunch outside today.
cards.example_zh: 今天风太大，没法在外面吃午饭。
cards.explain_zh: 天气义读/ˈwɪndi/；描述道路蜿蜒通常用winding。

cards.example_en: We stopped for petrol before driving into the mountains.
cards.example_zh: 开车进山前，我们停车加了汽油。
cards.explain_zh: 不可数名词；英式用petrol，美式用gasoline或gas。

cards.example_en: Higher petrol prices may encourage commuters to use public transport rather than drive to work.
cards.example_zh: 汽油价格上涨可能促使通勤者乘坐公共交通，而不是开车上班。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The swimming pool is quieter on weekday mornings.
cards.example_zh: 游泳池在工作日的早晨比较安静。
cards.explain_zh: 指周一至周五，不保证当天实际上需要上班。

cards.example_en: Extending library opening hours on weekdays would benefit students who work during the day.
cards.example_zh: 延长图书馆工作日的开放时间，将有利于白天工作的学生。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We explored old castles during our holiday in Scotland.
cards.example_zh: 我们在苏格兰度假时游览了古老的城堡。
cards.explain_zh: 苏格兰是英国的组成部分；形容词通常用Scottish。

cards.example_en: Someone pinned a lost cat poster to the noticeboard.
cards.example_zh: 有人把寻猫启事钉在了布告栏上。
cards.explain_zh: 英式常用noticeboard，美式常用bulletin board。

cards.example_en: We keep our car and bicycles in the garage.
cards.example_zh: 我们把汽车和自行车停在车库里。
cards.explain_zh: 英式英语也常用 garage 指汽车修理厂。

cards.example_en: My classmate lent me a pencil before the lesson.
cards.example_zh: 上课前，我的同班同学借给我一支铅笔。
cards.explain_zh: classmate指同班同学，schoolmate指同校同学。

cards.example_en: The clean bowls are in the cupboard above the sink.
cards.example_zh: 干净的碗放在水槽上方的橱柜里。
cards.explain_zh: cupboard中的p不发音；通常指带门的储物柜。

cards.example_en: The weather grew worse as we climbed the hill.
cards.example_zh: 我们爬山时，天气变得更糟了。
cards.explain_zh: bad和badly的比较级；最高级是worst。

cards.example_en: We played cricket in the park after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭后，我们在公园里打板球。
cards.explain_zh: 指板球运动时不可数；指蟋蟀时可数。

cards.example_en: We watched a shark swim slowly behind the aquarium glass.
cards.example_zh: 我们看着一条鲨鱼在水族馆的玻璃后缓缓游动。
cards.explain_zh: loan shark指放高利贷者，不是某种鲨鱼。

cards.example_en: The museum displays pottery from several different Asian countries.
cards.example_zh: 这家博物馆展出了多个亚洲国家的陶器。
cards.explain_zh: 首字母须大写；Asia是洲名，Asian可作形容词。

cards.example_en: The museum displays pottery from several different Asian countries.
cards.example_zh: 这家博物馆展出了多个亚洲国家的陶器。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: There is a washroom just beside the lifts.
cards.example_zh: 电梯旁边就有一间洗手间。
cards.explain_zh: 主要用于北美，尤其加拿大；英国常说toilet。

cards.example_en: Every public library should provide an accessible washroom to accommodate visitors with a range of mobility needs.
cards.example_zh: 每座公共图书馆都应配备无障碍洗手间，以满足行动能力各异的访客的需求。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.meaning_zh: 令人惊讶的；出乎意料的
cards.example_en: The tiny bakery offers a surprising variety of fresh bread.
cards.example_zh: 这家小面包店的新鲜面包种类多得令人惊讶。
cards.explain_zh: surprising形容事物；surprised形容人的感受。

cards.example_en: We stayed indoors and baked bread on that snowy afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 那个下雪的下午，我们待在屋里烤面包。
cards.explain_zh: snowy可描述天气，也可指地面等被雪覆盖。

cards.example_en: I spilled orange soda all over the kitchen floor.
cards.example_zh: 我把橙味汽水洒得厨房地板上到处都是。
cards.explain_zh: 美式常指汽水；baking soda才是小苏打。

cards.example_en: Replacing sugary soda with water can help reduce daily sugar intake and support better dental health.
cards.example_zh: 用水代替含糖汽水有助于减少每日糖摄入，并改善牙齿健康。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We played ping-pong together while waiting for dinner.
cards.example_zh: 等晚饭时，我们一起打了乒乓球。
cards.explain_zh: 较口语化；正式比赛和写作常用table tennis。

cards.example_en: My nephew proudly showed me his new bicycle.
cards.example_zh: 我的侄子自豪地给我看他的新自行车。
cards.explain_zh: nephew 指男性晚辈；女性对应词是 niece。

cards.example_en: We went skateboarding at the park after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭后，我们去公园玩滑板了。
cards.explain_zh: 运动用skateboarding；滑板这件器材用skateboard。

cards.example_en: Dedicated skateboarding facilities give young people safe spaces to exercise and develop their balance and coordination.
cards.example_zh: 专用滑板设施为年轻人提供了安全的锻炼空间，帮助他们提高平衡感和协调能力。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Wash the lettuce before adding it to your sandwich.
cards.example_zh: 把生菜洗净后再夹进三明治里。
cards.explain_zh: 指食材通常不可数；一棵生菜用a head of lettuce。

cards.example_en: I packed a warm jumper for the camping trip.
cards.example_zh: 我为这次露营带了一件暖和的套头毛衣。
cards.explain_zh: 英式英语指套头毛衣；美式通常用sweater。

cards.example_en: Her granddaughter brought fresh flowers when she visited on Sunday.
cards.example_zh: 她的孙女星期天来看她时带来了鲜花。
cards.explain_zh: 既指孙女也指外孙女，英语不区分父系与母系。

cards.example_en: The library's homepage has a photo of its new reading room.
cards.example_zh: 图书馆主页上有一张新阅览室的照片。
cards.explain_zh: 也可写作home page；不等于网站中的任意网页。

cards.example_en: The view from the mountain was absolutely amazing.
cards.example_zh: 从山上望去的景色真是令人惊叹。
cards.explain_zh: amazing形容令人惊叹的事物；amazed形容人的感受。

cards.example_en: The view from the mountain was absolutely amazing.
cards.example_zh: 从山上望去的景色真是令人惊叹。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: As a housewife, she manages a busy household.
cards.example_zh: 作为家庭主妇，她操持着一个忙碌家庭的日常事务。
cards.explain_zh: 复数为housewives；homemaker不限定性别。

cards.example_en: There is one chocolate cookie left in the jar.
cards.example_zh: 罐子里还剩一块巧克力曲奇。
cards.explain_zh: 美式泛指小甜饼；网站cookie不等同于缓存文件。

cards.example_en: We found the missing kitten asleep behind the sofa.
cards.example_zh: 我们发现那只找不到的小猫正在沙发后面睡觉。
cards.explain_zh: missing作形容词表不见或缺失；be missing from表缺少。

cards.example_en: Missing data can undermine the reliability of research findings and lead policymakers to draw inaccurate conclusions.
cards.example_zh: 数据缺失会削弱研究结果的可靠性，并导致政策制定者得出不准确的结论。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Keep your ticket in the left-hand pocket of your jacket.
cards.example_zh: 把票放在夹克左侧的口袋里。
cards.explain_zh: left-hand指左侧；left-handed指惯用左手的。

cards.example_en: Separating cyclists from vehicles in the left-hand lane could make this busy road safer for everyone.
cards.example_zh: 将骑行者与左侧车道的车辆隔开，可以让这条繁忙道路对所有人都更安全。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: She dipped a biscuit into her warm tea.
cards.example_zh: 她把一块饼干浸进温热的茶里。
cards.explain_zh: 英式biscuit通常对应美式cookie；美式另指松软面包。

cards.example_en: We spotted several African elephants beside a muddy waterhole.
cards.example_zh: 我们在一个泥泞的水塘边发现了几头非洲象。
cards.explain_zh: 首字母须大写；表示来自非洲，不限定肤色。

cards.example_en: Many African countries are investing in solar energy to improve electricity access in remote rural communities.
cards.example_zh: 许多非洲国家正投资太阳能，以改善偏远农村社区的电力供应。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We went skiing together during our winter holiday.
cards.example_zh: 寒假期间，我们一起去滑雪了。
cards.explain_zh: 滑雪用go skiing；滑水需说water skiing。

cards.example_en: I forgot my password and couldn't open my account.
cards.example_zh: 我忘了密码，无法登录账户。
cards.explain_zh: password是密码；passcode也可指数字口令。

cards.example_en: I dropped the birthday card into the postbox outside.
cards.example_zh: 我把生日贺卡投进了外面的邮筒。
cards.explain_zh: 英式英语指公共寄信邮筒；美式通常用mailbox。

cards.example_en: The film had a surprisingly cheerful ending for everyone.
cards.example_zh: 这部电影的结局出人意料，所有人都皆大欢喜。
cards.explain_zh: 故事结局用ending；at the end表示在末尾。

cards.example_en: A helicopter landed in the field behind our house.
cards.example_zh: 一架直升机降落在我们屋后的田野里。
cards.explain_zh: 乘直升机用by helicopter，中间不加冠词。

cards.example_en: A rescue helicopter can reach isolated communities when floods make roads unsafe for emergency vehicles.
cards.example_zh: 当洪水使道路无法供救援车辆安全通行时，救援直升机可以抵达被困的偏远社区。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Her untidy desk was covered with cups and notebooks.
cards.example_zh: 她凌乱的书桌上堆满了杯子和笔记本。
cards.explain_zh: untidy强调不整齐，不一定像dirty那样有污垢。

word.example_en: The swimming pool is quieter on weekday mornings.
word.example_zh: 游泳池在工作日的早晨比较安静。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Recent medical research has produced amazing results, offering new hope to patients with previously untreatable conditions.
word.example_zh: 近期医学研究取得了惊人的成果，为患有过去无法治疗的疾病的患者带来了新希望。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
